arxiv-2407-08702.title: Production and stabilization of a spin mixture of ultracold dipolar Bose gases
arxiv-2407-08702.creator: Maxime Lecomte, Alexandre Journeaux, Julie Veschambre, Jean Dalibard, Raphael Lopes
arxiv-2407-08702.description: Abstract Mixtures of ultracold gases with long-range interactions are expected to open new avenues in the study of quantum matter. Natural candidates for this research are spin mixtures of atomic species with large magnetic moments. However, the lifetime of such assemblies can be strongly affected by the dipolar relaxation that occurs in spin-flip collisions.

arxiv-2503-18287.title: Solar Radio Burst Detection Based on Deformable DETR Thanks: Citation : Mingming Wang et al. Solar Radio Burst Detection Based on Deformable DETR. Accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal Supplement.
arxiv-2503-18287.creator: Mingming Wang, Guowu Yuan*, Hao Zhou, Chengming Tan, Hao Wu
arxiv-2503-18287.description: Abstract Solar radio bursts (SRBs) detection is crucial for solar physics research and space weather forecasting. The main challenges faced are noise interference in the spectrum and the diversity of SRBs. However, most research focuses on classifying whether SRBs exist or detecting a single type of SRBs. Existing detection models exhibit deficiencies in the accuracy of SRBs detection.

arxiv-2505-21779.title: Magnetic 2 ​ π 2\pi domain walls for tunable Majorana devices
arxiv-2505-21779.creator: Daniel Hauck, Stefan Rex, Markus Garst
arxiv-2505-21779.description: Abstract Identifying realistic platforms capable of controlled operations with Majorana bound states is a key challenge in the study of topological superconductivity. Among the most promising proposals are magnet-superconductor hybrid devices, which employ magnetic textures to engineer regions of non-trivial topology.

arxiv-2507-13286.title: Privacy-Preserving Fusion for Multi-Sensor Systems Under Multiple Packet Dropouts
arxiv-2507-13286.creator: Jie Huang, and Jason J. R. Liu
arxiv-2507-13286.description: Abstract Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are critical components in modern cyber-physical systems, enabling efficient data collection and fusion through spatially distributed sensors. However, the inherent risks of eavesdropping and packet dropouts in such networks pose significant challenges to secure state estimation.

arxiv-2510-02240.title: RewardMap: Tackling Sparse Rewards in Fine-grained Visual Reasoning via Multi-Stage Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2510-02240.creator: Sicheng Feng, Kaiwen Tuo, Song Wang, Lingdong Kong, Jianke Zhu, Huan Wang, [1ex] Westlake University, [1ex] Equal contribution. Corresponding author
arxiv-2510-02240.description: Abstract Fine-grained visual reasoning remains a core challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). The recently introduced ReasonMap highlights this gap by showing that even advanced MLLMs struggle with spatial reasoning in structured and information-rich settings such as transit maps, a task of clear practical and scientific importance.

arxiv-2602-18494.title: On the Dynamics of Observation and Semantics
arxiv-2602-18494.creator: Xiu Li
arxiv-2602-18494.description: Abstract A dominant paradigm in visual intelligence treats semantics as a static property of latent representations, assuming that meaning can be discovered through geometric proximity in high-dimensional embedding spaces. In this work, we argue that this view is physically incomplete.

However, its rapid chemical degradation in ambient conditions hinders practical applications.

pmc-13400764.title: Unique presentation of urosymphyseal fistula and conservative management
pmc-13400764.creator: Cristian J. Salazar V., David A. Woodrum, Maximilian Staebler, Matvey Tsivian, Lance A. Mynderse, Brian J. Davis
pmc-13400764.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A urosymphyseal fistula is an abnormal connection between the lower urinary tract (typically bladder or proximal urethra) and pubic symphysis. This is an uncommon late complication of prostate cancer treatment, often occurring after pelvic radiation and urethral instrumentation. We report a 79-year-old man who, after external radiotherapy, salvage brachytherapy, and transurethral bladder neck incision, developed a urosymphyseal fistula with urinary tracking into the anterior thigh compartment. Given comorbidities, he was managed conservatively with urinary diversion, percutaneous drainage, and antibiotic therapy.

pmc-13519879.creator: Shiguo Zuo, Lijun He, Zhiying Hou, Quanliang Tian, Yilong Yang, Weichen Huang
pmc-13519879.description: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a whole-joint disease in which mechanical exposure and low-grade sterile inflammation interact, but their coexistence does not by itself explain why a normally adaptive response becomes self-sustaining.
